decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core finishing range with no negative market signal yet, it is still a relatively low-cost option worth keeping while demand becomes clearer.

Although this UV spot varnishing system is farther from the established offer and therefore costlier to support, its flagship positioning means management is likely to preserve the option for another year unless evidence turns clearly weak.

Because this sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's existing portfolio and should be inexpensive to carry alongside it, the firm would likely keep it while adoption uncertainty remains.
This B2 multifinisher is both close to the core business and explicitly highlighted as a strategic focus, so the firm has strong reason to continue backing it as a key growth option.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's established postpress business, and without evidence of failure the option value of staying in the market still outweighs the likely carrying cost.
The folding add-on already shows a concrete customer use case and is a close, modular add-on to the firm's core systems, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
